msg: Control flow of non-void function ends here!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (NEW): 0f8f8094d28.c (Linux kmalloc). 'Control flow of non-void function ends here' at lines 45-54, when !def(CONFIG_LOCKDEP). When LOCKDEP=false, the #else branch defines 'init_node_lock_keys()' without a return type (line 50: K&R/C89-style implicit int) but with an empty body — the function never returns a value despite having an implicit int return type. This is a genuine control flow bug. NEW: the known vbdb bug for this file is the OutOfBoundsRead/UndeclaredIdentifier on kmalloc_caches when SLOB=true; this control flow issue is a separate, distinct bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: !def(LOCKDEP) is exactly the condition that compiles the else-branch stub with the missing return.
